about.title: About
about.p1: Crypto Alert is the specialized course project of a student at the University of Information Technology (UIT, VNU-HCM): a web application for cryptocurrency market tracking with real-time technical charts and price alerts.
about.p2: It shows USDT spot pairs from Binance, candlestick charts with MA, RSI and MACD, a watchlist, one-shot price alerts and in-app notifications. The interface is available in Vietnamese and English, in a dark or light theme.
about.p3: Price data comes from the public Binance API and is called only by this project's server; the browser never talks to Binance directly. Charts use the TradingView Lightweight Charts™ library.
about.p4: Technically: React and TypeScript on the front end, NestJS and PostgreSQL on the server, Socket.IO for real-time data, automated tests with Playwright.

community-rules.title: Community rules
community-rules.p1: The community area (ideas, comments) is planned and is not part of the current version. These rules will apply when it opens.
community-rules.p2: Respect others: no personal attacks, discrimination or harassment.
community-rules.p3: No advertising, referral links, scams or spam.
community-rules.p4: Do not post personal information about yourself or others.
community-rules.p5: Trading ideas are shared for discussion only and are not investment advice; no guaranteed returns.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.p1: Crypto Alert is a learning project. The service is provided "as is", without any warranty of accuracy, availability or fitness for a particular purpose.
terms.p2: The information shown is for reference only and is not investment advice. You are responsible for your own decisions.
terms.p3: The application does not allow real-money trading, order entry or linking exchange accounts.
terms.p4: You must not abuse the service, for example by sending unusual volumes of requests or trying to access other users' data. Violating accounts may be blocked.
terms.p5: Market data belongs to its source (Binance) and is subject to that source's terms.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: When you register, the application stores your email, display name and a password hash (argon2id); the password itself is never stored.
privacy.p2: It also stores your preferences (language, theme, time zone), your watchlist, your price alerts and your notifications. This data is visible only to you.
privacy.p3: The application uses no tracking analytics, shows no advertising and does not sell or share your data with third parties.
privacy.p4: One sign-in cookie (refresh_token, httpOnly) keeps you signed in for up to 7 days; see the Cookie policy.
privacy.p5: To delete your account and data, get in touch through the Contact page.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.p1: The application uses a single cookie: refresh_token. It is an httpOnly cookie, sent only to the /api/v1/auth path, expires after 7 days and keeps you signed in.
cookies.p2: The application uses no advertising or tracking cookies.
cookies.p3: Some choices are stored in your browser (localStorage) on your device: language, theme, indicator settings, screen layout, recently opened pairs and chart type.
cookies.p4: You can delete this data at any time in your browser settings.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: Information is for reference only and is not investment advice.
disclaimer.p2: Prices, charts and indicators may be delayed, incomplete or inaccurate. Price alerts may not be delivered if market data is interrupted.
disclaimer.p3: Trading cryptocurrencies is high risk and you can lose all of your capital. Do your own research before deciding.
disclaimer.p4: The project author is not liable for any loss arising from the use of this application.
